description: Source file defining the VoiceWakeRuntime actor, which manages voice wake word detection and speech recognition for the application, including session management, recognition pipeline controls, audio level monitoring, and integration with system components like AVFoundation and Speech.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntime
classes.description: An actor responsible for voice wake word detection, speech recognition, and session management, enabling voice commands outside of the settings test view.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the recognition runtime based on the current app state, starting or stopping the pipeline as needed.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition pipeline with provided configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the recognition pipeline and clears related resources.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures the speech recognizer for a specified locale.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition updates including transcriptions, errors, and trigger detection, and manages capture state transitions.

methods.name: maybeLogRecognition
methods.description: Logs recognition transcripts and matches for debugging purposes.

methods.name: noteAudioTap
methods.description: Logs the RMS level of audio taps for debugging.

methods.name: noteRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Logs empty recognition callbacks for debugging.

methods.name: scheduleTriggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check for trigger-only pauses to detect wake word triggers.

methods.name: schedulePreDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a silence detection check to trigger fallback recognition.

methods.name: triggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Checks if the system should enter capture based on trigger-only state.

methods.name: isTriggerOnly
methods.description: Determines whether the transcript matches only trigger words.

methods.name: preDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Performs silence detection fallback recognition if no speech is detected within a time window.

methods.name: beginCapture
methods.description: Begins capturing speech after detecting a wake word or trigger.

methods.name: monitorCapture
methods.description: Monitors ongoing capture for silence or maximum duration to finalize recognition.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Ends audio capture, processes the final transcript, updates UI overlays, and forwards the result.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Adjusts adaptive noise floor and updates UI with current audio RMS level.

methods.name: restartRecognizer
methods.description: Restarts the speech recognizer for the next detection cycle.

methods.name: restartRecognizerIfIdleAndOverlayHidden
methods.description: Restarts recognition if idle and overlay is hidden.

methods.name: scheduleRestartRecognizer
methods.description: Schedules a recognition restart after a delay.

methods.name: consumeScheduledRestart
methods.description: Clears the scheduled restart task.

methods.name: applyPushToTalkCooldown
methods.description: Applies a cooldown period after push-to-talk to prevent immediate re-trigger.

methods.name: pauseForPushToTalk
methods.description: Pauses the recognition for push-to-talk mode and stops current recognition pipeline.

methods.name: updateHeardBeyondTrigger
methods.description: Updates state indicating speech was heard beyond the trigger point.

methods.name: trimmedAfterTrigger
methods.description: Returns the command text after the trigger word, trimming leading trigger parts.

methods.name: commandAfterTrigger
methods.description: Extracts the command part of the transcript after the trigger, considering trigger end time if specified.
